description: Main source file for the Flutter frontend of a matchmaking app, setting up app theme, filters, and match fetching logic.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget configuring theme and home page.

classes.name: CanonicalOption
classes.description: Represents filter option with display label and machine key.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: Data model for filter criteria with URL query builder.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enum for hair color options used in filters.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Stateful widget providing filter UI and match results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes app, loads environment variables, and runs MyApp.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Constructs a color scheme based on brightness settings.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Builds Flutter ThemeData from color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds MaterialApp with themes and home page.

methods.name: _applyFilters
methods.description: Triggers filter query, handles loading/error states, and updates results.

methods.name: _buildDropdownItems
methods.description: Creates dropdown menu items from options list.
